protocol.prompt: Inspect this thermal image for provisional mine-like ground signatures. Return ONLY JSON {"detections":[{"bbox":{"x_min":0,"y_min":0,"x_max":1000,"y_max":1000}}]}. Boxes must tightly bound visible evidence, normalized to 0..1000. Return an empty detections list when no supported candidate is visible. Thermal appearance does not confirm a physical mine.
protocol.scope: Development perception comparison; not native mission-policy evaluation
protocol.note: Same visible prompt and images as Gemma; frontier receives native JSON mode and 8192 total output tokens including its default reasoning, versus Gemma greedy 192 output tokens. No ground truth sent.
